claim: The calendar Q2 2024 number for Amazon's diluted EPS was near $1.36.
summary: Amazon's reported calendar Q2 2024 diluted EPS was $1.29 per the August 1, 2024 earnings release, not near $1.36. The claimed $1.36 overstates the actual reported result by $0.07 (~5.4%).

sub_claims.text: Amazon's diluted EPS for calendar Q2 2024 was near $1.36
sub_claims.stated_text: The calendar Q2 2024 number for Amazon's diluted EPS was near $1.36.
sub_claims.note: Per Amazon Q2 2024 results reported Aug 1, 2024, diluted EPS was $1.29 on net income of $13.5 billion, versus $0.65 a year earlier. $1.36 is materially higher and outside reasonable 'near' tolerance for EPS.
